originalIntent: Produce and verify a staged Todo 7 physics player with the pinned Unity 2019.3.4f1 build, legacy request 62 and request 70 compatibility, complete EditMode coverage, checksum/provenance validation, and protected-root rollback guarantees.
desiredOutcome: A promotable staged archive whose runtime and static evidence satisfy every Todo 7 acceptance criterion without modifying the canonical project, production player, or active dataset.
userOutcomeReview: The archive is present and its SHA-256 matches the requested final archive hash. Static verification, wrong-SHA rejection, and 26 focused Python tests pass; the parseable EditMode partition receipt totals 33/33. However, the shipped claim is blocked: the build/provenance identify Unity 2019.4.41f2 rather than the pinned 2019.3.4f1, and canonical protected-root comparison is nonzero due to two lifecycle test files. Independent live protocol artifacts show request 62 timeout and request 70 invalid-envelope timeout, so runtime compatibility is not independently proven despite newer symbolic-runtime success prose.
